title: NBL Season 1
summary:
Reunite. Rally. Relive: 

Navodaya Badminton League 2026

The JNV Chikkamagaluru Alumni Association is hosting the Navodaya Badminton Tournament, an exciting sports event bringing former students together to reconnect, reminisce, and showcase their skills on the court.

Event Highlights
 * Organizer: JNV Chikkamagaluru Alumni
 * Event: Navodaya Badminton League
 * Date: Sunday, 1st November 2026
 * Venue: SportFit, JP Nagar, Bengaluru
 * Participation: 40 Teams competing

Join in to celebrate sportsmanship, relive old school memories, and make it a day to remember!
